answer: Each identity must carve marble, a stone that only yields to slow work. Honest marble is carved over years; a farm's is cast in a mold, identical statues. Every identity must keep a haven, where its deeds rest. Honest havens shelter many ships; a farm's the same boats, docked one hour. Trust is copper, mined, smelted, and hammered into shape. Honest copper is mined in many places, hammered by many hands; a farm's comes from one mine, one furnace, one day. To pass, a farm must carve real marble, keep a real haven, and mine real copper for every sockpuppet.
